By default, will map the following library type names to modality names:
  - Gene Expression: rna
  - Peaks: atac
  - Antibody Capture: prot
  - VDJ: vdj
  - VDJ-T: vdj_t
  - VDJ-B: vdj_b
  - CRISPR Guide Capture: crispr
  - Multiplexing Capture: hashing
  
Other library types have their whitepace removed and dashes replaced by
underscores to generate the modality name.

Currently does not allow parsing the output from cell barcode demultiplexing.


::: {.ref-description}
- Gene Expression: rna
  - Peaks: atac
  - Antibody Capture: prot
  - VDJ: vdj
  - VDJ-T: vdj_t
  - VDJ-B: vdj_b
  - CRISPR Guide Capture: crispr
  - Multiplexing Capture: hashing

Other library types have their whitepace removed and dashes replaced by
underscores to generate the modality name.

Currently does not allow parsing the output from cell barcode demultiplexing.
:::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_cellranger_multi_to_h5mu/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/convert/from_cellranger_multi_to_h5mu);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_cellranger_multi_to_h5mu/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
